items.title: Iran-US deal still out of reach despite heightened diplomatic efforts

items.title: Russell stars with bat and ball as Biratnagar edge Janakpur

items.desc: Andre Russell smashed an unbeaten 52 off 29 balls after half-centuries from Lokesh Bam and Imran Sheikh to give Biratnagar a competitive total in Kirtipur.

items.desc: The CIAA alleges that government officials colluded to let a company exchange valuable land in Biratnagar, which should have been confiscated, for cheaper plots.

items.title: Two of eight inmates who escaped Dolpa prison arrested in Rukum West
items.desc: Police arrested the two men during a vehicle check in Aathbiskot Municipality on Tuesday morning. Six others remain at large.

items.title: How Deepak Bhatta became Nepal’s most influential power broker
items.desc: For two decades, Bhatta cultivated extraordinary access to Nepal’s political and bureaucratic elite while keeping himself largely out of public view. A money-laundering investigation has now exposed the networks around him.

items.title: Indian national killed, New Zealander injured in mid-air chopper collision near Everest
items.desc: In what is believed to be Nepal’s first mid-air helicopter collision, two choppers struck each other while attempting to land at Pheriche, raising fresh concerns over flight safety and the growing number of helicopter operations in the Everest region.

items.title: Janakpur and Lumbini eye top spot in NPL double-header
items.desc: Janakpur face Biratnagar in the first match before Lumbini take on Pokhara, who are yet to win a game. The fixtures will also mark the final NPL appearances of Moeen Ali and Andre Russell.

items.title: Six reasons Democrats may fall short of a midterm landslide
items.desc: A shrinking number of competitive races, uncertain Senate contests, turnout challenges and a Republican fundraising edge could limit Democratic gains despite widespread voter dissatisfaction with Donald Trump.

items.title: Kathmandu metropolis bans sale of plastic flowers and garlands ahead of Tihar
items.desc: The move aims to protect local flower growers and ensure that sales are concentrated at designated locations across the capital.

items.title: Protect Nepalis in Saudi Arabia
items.desc: Houthi drones have killed a Nepali worker. Diplomacy must protect the rest and bring the stranded home.

items.title: Nepal and India agree to step up cooperation on border security
items.desc: The two security forces will share intelligence and coordinate efforts to curb smuggling, human trafficking, counterfeit currency and drug trafficking.

items.title: Indian tourist killed as two helicopters collide in Solukhumbu
items.desc: New Zealand citizen of Indian origin and both pilots were also injured in the collision at Pheriche.

items.desc: Two months on, many elderly survivors remain displaced, haunted by memories of the disaster and waiting for news of missing family members. Authorities are yet to establish how many older people were affected.

items.desc: Maxwell bows out after 14 years, having helped Australia win two ODI World Cups and a T20 World Cup, but misses out on a farewell match at the MCG.

items.desc: Filmmakers say social media campaigns based on trailers and short clips threaten creative freedom, while critics insist they have the right to question religious representations.

items.desc: War and Gulf localisation policies are shrinking overseas hiring, and a migration-dependent economy has little to fall back on.

items.desc: The hospital lacks several essential services. Doctors question its ability to provide the clinical training medical students need.

items.desc: Kathmandu have now beaten Karnali in all three NPL seasons, chasing down 181 with two balls to spare in their latest encounter.

items.desc: A full court meeting on Monday said it will not investigate allegations against its own members.

items.desc: Police chiefs in nine districts have served for over a year. Officers say morale and leadership development are suffering.

items.desc: Brandon McMullen’s 43 and an unbeaten 20 from Aarif Sheikh helped the Royals chase down a target of 130 in 16.4 overs.

items.desc: American arrivals surged 31 percent in October, while Indian visitors fell 30 percent as the August floods disrupted pilgrimage routes and dampened travel from Nepal’s traditionally biggest source market.
